notes.title: Caldera v1.03 - Chemistry
notes.notes:
Caldera v1.03 is now Live.

Fascinating first week on Steam, special thanks to everyone who commented and gave suggestions!

First Chemistry push is now live.  Located next to the Bogan, "Colorado Bob" will buy your Minerals in Powder form after they are processed at the Hammermill.
